## Description

Re-advertised. This role was first posted on 18 Jul 2026 and is being re-advertised.

About Merlion Ledger

Merlion Ledger runs payouts and reconciliation for Singapore marketplaces and platforms. Our Go services move merchant settlements every business day and reconcile them against bank and wallet statements.

Responsibilities

- Design, build and operate backend services in Go for payouts and reconciliation on AWS.

- Make payment webhooks and settlement jobs idempotent and safe to retry.

- Own PostgreSQL schemas and tune the queries behind merchant-facing APIs.

- Take part in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

Requirements

- 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

- Go in production.

- PostgreSQL: schema design and query tuning.

- AWS (SQS, RDS, EC2) and Docker; CI/CD pipelines.

- Payments or fintech experience is an advantage.

Work arrangement

- Fully remote. Work from Singapore or Malaysia; the team keeps core hours on Singapore time.

Eligibility

- Singapore Citizens and PRs only (client contract requirement).
